details: The Ethereum Foundation is restructuring its Protocol team, appointing Will Corcoran, Kev Wedderburn, and Fredrik as new co-leads. This reorganization, which follows previous transformation efforts, aims to advance major scaling upgrades like "Glamsterdam," which will increase the gas limit and introduce Enshrined Proposer-Builder Separation (ePBS).
title: Ethereum Foundation Reorganizes, Names New Protocol Co-Leads

details: Bitcoin's price is maintaining stability around $82,000, significantly bolstered by robust inflows into spot Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs). April alone saw approximately $1.9 billion in net inflows, pushing cumulative inflows since 2024 close to $58 billion, highlighting sustained institutional demand for Bitcoin.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $82K Amid Strong ETF Inflows

details: Solana has initiated testing of its groundbreaking "Alpenglow" consensus upgrade on a community validator test cluster. This upgrade is touted as the most significant consensus change in Solana's history, designed to drastically reduce transaction finality from approximately 12 seconds to about 150 milliseconds, potentially enhancing network scalability and attracting further development.
title: Solana Launches "Alpenglow" Consensus Upgrade on Test Cluster

details: Over the past 30 days, Bitcoin whales have aggressively accumulated 270,000 BTC, marking the largest single-month whale purchase since 2013. Concurrently, Bitcoin exchange reserves have fallen to a seven-year low of 2.21 million BTC, representing the smallest share of circulating supply since December 2017. This trend suggests reduced selling pressure and could signal a market bottom.
title: Bitcoin Whales Accumulate 270K BTC, Exchange Reserves Hit 7-Year Low

details: Mike Novogratz's Galaxy Digital is collaborating with Ethereum treasury company Sharplink to introduce the "Galaxy Sharplink Onchain Yield Fund," a $125 million investment vehicle. The fund aims to generate higher returns within the decentralized finance (DeFi) sector, with Sharplink contributing $100 million from its ether treasury.
title: Galaxy Digital, Sharplink Launch $125M DeFi Fund

details: Some analysts are cautioning that Bitcoin's recent price recovery might be a "dead cat bounce," foreseeing a potential 50% crash that could push BTC towards the $40,000 level. One analyst estimates the current bear market is approximately 55% complete based on historical cycles, while others point to high open interest and altcoin momentum as potential triggers for liquidation-driven sell-offs.
title: Analysts Warn of Potential Bitcoin Crash to $40K, Bear Market 55% Complete

details: On May 11, 2026, the broader cryptocurrency market displayed a predominantly bullish sentiment, with 284 out of 390 tracked tokens registering price increases. Notable performers included OSMOUSDT, SUI, and PSGUSDT, all experiencing significant double-digit percentage gains within the 24-hour period.
title: Crypto Market Sees Bullish Trend, 284 Tokens Rising on May 11
